title: Class 1 'tetra' objects fly in formations of three to twenty

tellings.quote: Yes, the objects of the first class usually They fly in groups.

plain: James Valor, from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call UFOs into view, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about what his team calls Class 1 objects, or "tetras." He says that in their field work between about 2021 and 2025, these objects usually fly in groups, anywhere from three to twenty at once. If true, it would mean these objects move in coordinated formations rather than alone.
